headline: No documented shared channels or overlapping writes; main residual risk is low-confidence inference from sparse docs.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile documents a shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, or parser that would let nuwa-skill inject instructions into taipy. nuwa-skill only shows allowlisted egress, while taipy shows no ingress surface or output parsing path. With no documented bridge, the pathway is not evidenced.
conditions: IF a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP bridge is added between nuwa-skill and taipy, reassess prompt-injection risk.
IF taipy begins parsing nuwa-skill output as instructions, the severity increases.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Disable any future MCP or message-queue bridge unless provenance checks are added.
Review taipy parsers before connecting external text sources.
requires-engineering: add content provenance labels on all cross-agent inputs.

B_data_leakage.rationale: The profiles do not show a shared workspace, shared OAuth principal, or any data classes touched by either agent. nuwa-skill has allowlisted egress and taipy has none, but without a shared data path there is no documented leakage route between them.
conditions: IF both agents are mounted on the same workspace or filesystem, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF either agent is later granted access to sensitive data classes, reassess exfiltration exposure.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared workspace between the agents.
Keep taipy on a separate account or principal.
Confirm nuwa-skill egress allowlist excludes sensitive endpoints.
requires-engineering: add per-agent storage isolation and access logs.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write capability is documented. nuwa-skill exposes only allowlisted network egress, and taipy shows no filesystem, database, or OAuth write scopes. Without shared mutable resources, a capability conflict is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or database, conflict risk becomes relevant.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state without locking, reassess.
mitigations: Keep write permissions absent unless needed.
Separate any future mutable resources by agent.
Avoid shared git working trees.
requires-engineering: add locking for any shared mutable resource.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no evidence that taipy treats nuwa-skill output as authoritative or that either agent has downstream action-taking authority in this pair. nuwa-skill is a scientific-research package and taipy is a data-engineering tool, but the profiles do not document an output-to-action pipeline.
conditions: IF taipy is configured to consume nuwa-skill outputs without verification, cascading-error risk appears.
IF either agent is connected to email, deployment, or commit actions, reassess.
mitigations: Insert a human review step before any action.
Require schema validation on cross-agent outputs.
Log and diff all intermediate artifacts.
requires-engineering: add automated verification gates before downstream actions.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent, so no compliance mismatch is evidenced. Because the profiles are sparse, this is a documentation-based non-finding rather than proof of compliance.
conditions: IF either agent later processes regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF retention or residency settings are introduced, reassess mismatch risk.
mitigations: Document data residency for both agents.
Record retention settings before deployment.
Avoid regulated data until policies are confirmed.
requires-engineering: add compliance policy checks to deployment.
